authorization: User explicitly chose Prepare a new design for review; implementation still requires completed design review.
classification: NEWLY_AUTHORED warehouse mechanic, team and added dialogue; original intro, sign text and exits retained.
scope: Complete the promised warehouse puzzle/battle only; no onward region, warp reroute, new badge/rank/item reward or other fixes.

rock.policy: Prefer Iron Tail; Rock Smash is an explicit new fallback for saves without the consumable-TM move. Native non-egg move check; fainted members count; no PP/items consumed.

native_asset_evidence.interpretation: Existing LC rock objects corroborate the pinned rock graphics constant; duplicate candidate map associations are retained.

npc.policy: Shown only during the locked challenge scene; hidden again on decline, battle return or map initialization. If player occupies primary position, use fallback.

retry_sign.policy: Preserve original damaged clue; after puzzle solve, offer the challenge without another move check. Completed state shows completion text without another battle.

state.policy: Preserve 0/1. Tagged states stay below 0x4000 for literal map-table operands. Unknown/legacy 2/3 recover to 1 without replaying intro or granting completion. Completed requires tagged state plus trainer bit; inconsistent pair falls back to solved retry. A bare trainer bit never establishes completion.
state.pre_intro_policy: For state 0 ensure original object 1 is visible at original (12,11), recovering a mismatched visibility flag if needed; original frame introduction then runs unchanged.

battle.name: Mister R
battle.completion: Clear owned candidate trainer bit before each attempt. After return, special B4 must equal exactly 1 before setting tagged completion. Non-win does not complete; clear stale defeated bit when control returns. Loss/whiteout leaves solved retry for reentry. Normal trainer prize money only; no extra reward.

hooks.init_policy: Preserve original tag-2 intro row. Add tag-4 one-shot conditional initialization after object spawn (operands 1==1; 0 is table terminator). Tag 7 reuses immediate visibility cleanup on field return. Initialization has no waits, prompts or battles.
copied_original_changes: object 1 script field points to guarded challenge handler
BG sign 1 script field points to clue/retry dispatcher
hooks.preserve: Original warp records, map blocks/tilesets/layout pointers, original introduction and its conditional table, other event records and object 2.
